customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be the best in the market with a premium appearance and user-friendly app. They appreciate its adjustable TDS levels, good taste without metallic or chemical aftertaste, and excellent installation process. The product receives positive feedback for its features and ease of use, though opinions about value for money are mixed.

reviews.author: sk
reviews.body: Prompt installation and excellent service with zero delays or extra charges! This purifier outperforms everything else on the market. The customizable features are fantastic and adapt perfectly to our needs. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Pradeep Kandaswamy
reviews.title: Atomberg Intellon - Great versatile purifier with smart TDS-based RO — recommended
reviews.body: Installed the Atomberg Intellon RO today (August 10, 2026), and overall, Very happy with the Atomberg Intellon so far. The TDS-based switching is a smart feature that reduces RO usage when it isn’t needed. This should help reduce wastewater while retaining more minerals, especially with the alkaliser. The water tastes clean and slightly alkaline, and the 8L tank is sufficient for our family of four. The technician installed a Pressure Reducing Value (PRV) free-of-cost as the input pressure was slightly high. The app monitoring and alerts work well, although the initial setup took a few minutes

reviews.author: Telugu techworld
reviews.title: Best Water purifier 👍
reviews.body: Delivery and installation were both super smooth, no hassle at all. Technician actually took the time to explain the product properly along with the app, didn't just install and leave. Best part for me is being able to set my own TDS range - water tastes so much better now, genuinely noticeable difference.

reviews.author: Srinath S
reviews.title: Good
reviews.body: The Atomberg Intellion RO performs well in terms of water purification. The design is modern, water quality is good, and the smart app features are useful when they work. Installation was smooth, and the purifier provides useful information such as filter status and water quality through the app. However, the biggest drawback is Wi-Fi management. If you change your home Wi-Fi name or router, reconnecting the purifier can be frustrating.
